answer.text:
According to Utz Brands, Inc.'s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 29, 2024, the gross profit margin percentage is:

### **1. Reported Data**
* **Gross profit:** $494,777 thousand (or $494.8 million)
* **Net sales:** $1,409,281 thousand (or $1,409.3 million)

*(Source: Part II, Item 7, "Results of Operations" / Item 8, Consolidated Statements of Operations, Accession: `0001739566-25-000053`, Chunk IDs: `14e6d7a8-d96c-5bc1-a7d5-febc26908e92` and `c9f988c9-0c08-55d0-8891-c0f3e4093e75`)*

---

### **2. Calculation**
$$\text{Gross Profit Margin} = \frac{\text{Gross profit}}{\text{Net sales}} = \frac{\$494,777}{\$1,409,281} \approx 35.1085\% \approx 35.1\%$$

The filing explicitly states in the discussion of Results of Operations:
> *"Our gross profit margin was 35.1% for the fiscal year ended December 29, 2024 versus 31.7% for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023."* *(Chunk ID: `14e6d7a8-d96c-5bc1-a7d5-febc26908e92`)*

Utz Brands, Inc.'s gross profit margin percentage for the fiscal year ended December 29, 2024, was **35.1%** (or approximately **35.11%** unrounded).
